<div class="msg"><small>Message</small><span>Session has been terminated</span></div>

## Why it happens

Your session was ended on purpose: you or an administrator changed the password, the user signed out, or the account was disabled. Sessions also end after a week without use.

## Fix it

Sign in again. If it happens again without a reason, ask an administrator whether your password was reset.

## Check that it worked

You stay signed in.
